The constraints force a unique schedule.

Hana, Dev and Elif must sit in consecutive slots, because exactly one person is between Elif and Hana and Hana comes before Dev, who comes before Elif. Ann must then be at Dev+2 (Ann at Dev−2 would put Cara before Elif, which is impossible). That fixes Finn at Ann+1 and Cara at Ann+2, and Gus at Finn+2. Ivo and Ben must both sit before Gus, which leaves only slots 1 and 2 for them, with Ivo first.

Checking all 13 constraints against SCHEDULE: Hana 3, Dev 4, Elif 5, Ann 6, Finn 7, Cara 8, Gus 9:
- Hana (3) before Dev (4), Dev (4) before Elif (5), Elif (5) before Finn (7): pass
- One person between Ann (6) and Dev (4), and between Ann (6) and Cara (8): pass
- One person between Elif (5) and Hana (3): pass
- Ivo (1) before Ben (2), and both before Gus (9): pass
- Ann (6) and Ben (2) are 4 apart; Elif (5) and Gus (9) are 4 apart: pass
- Cara (8) immediately after Finn (7): pass
- One person between Finn (7) and Gus (9): pass
